//: The implementations under test. Each step runs from `cwd` in bash; $SCRATCH is a fresh directory per step (deleted before its clean run, kept for the incremental one), so a clean build shares no cache with any other. A step that doesn't apply is null. A step with `after` runs once, warm, in that step's $SCRATCH (the test suite's run on its finished build). Paths are relative to the repo. build.ts runs every step on the same N CPUs (--jobs).
